# madusha.dev

> Portfolio and engineering blog of Madusha Sandaruwan, a software engineer specializing in resilient systems, cloud architecture, and full-stack web development.

## Site

- [Home](https://madusha.dev): Overview, services, projects, experience, contact.
- [Blog](https://madusha.dev/blog): Technical articles on systems design, software architecture, and building reliable products.

## Contact

- Email: work@madusha.dev
- GitHub: https://github.com/madushaS
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/madushasandaruwan

## Notes for crawlers

- Sitemap: https://madusha.dev/sitemap-index.xml
- Blog posts are prerendered static HTML with full text in the initial response; no JavaScript required to read content.
- Structured data: Person, WebSite, BlogPosting, and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on all pages.
